architecture_A1_A14.A1 System context: Owner authorizes one Codex-specific compatibility target and scope; tests observe existing host execution paths. This document refines a plan, not a provider integration.
architecture_A1_A14.A2 Hexagonal view: diagram_a; HOST and EXEC existing input/output boundaries reused, Codex process external and untrusted.
architecture_A1_A14.A3 Dependency view: diagram_b; no production dependency on this review/harness; no new repository/manager/Clock/PTY interface.
architecture_A1_A14.A4 Module responsibility: agent-compatibility owns provider-labelled case selection, observation and evidence layout. It cannot own claims/leases/approval or generate authoritative EvidenceRef validity.
architecture_A1_A14.A5 Input ports: Existing AgentPort request/poll/cancel and approved future claim/report input contracts only. No newly approved command/DTO here.
architecture_A1_A14.A6 Output ports: Existing ProcessPort for headless CLI. EVID/WORK/SPEC accesses only through already approved use-case boundaries; proposed future inbound contract remains conditional.
architecture_A1_A14.A7 Driving adapters: Dedicated Codex verification harness after approval; desktop/CLI/MCP input surfaces share only explicitly approved behavior, not assumed identical windows.
architecture_A1_A14.A8 Driven adapters: Existing process adapter; deterministic doubles provide simulation only. Real Codex invocation requires named approved path/version/argv/host; no invocation in this plan.
architecture_A1_A14.A9 Dependency direction: Test -> existing host/ports; OS adapter -> portable ports. Domain never imports provider SDK/browser/OS. No alternate UI-to-process route.
architecture_A1_A14.A10 State ownership: HOST/WORK own existing active-run/project lease/accounting state; EXEC owns event lifecycle; product documents remain product state authority. Human approval authority is not established merely by HOST fields. Compatibility matrix is derived and nonauthoritative.
architecture_A1_A14.A11 Mutation boundary: Compatibility tests cannot set acceptance/green, self-classify task intent or mutate approval. Child-claimed identity/PASS untrusted. Approved host use cases alone may change run/lease/evidence state.
architecture_A1_A14.A12 Transaction boundary: Preflight+binding before start; cancel ACK retains pending state and output until explicit terminal; terminal reconciles lease once. Report/evidence transaction follows owner-approved upstream contract, not invented child claims.
architecture_A1_A14.A13 External boundary: Codex executable/auth/runtime, direct child process and optional inbound transport. No current provider API/version lookup, secrets, network or Agent launch performed.
architecture_A1_A14.A14 Forbidden dependencies: No provider defaults as normative contract; no Claude PASS inheritance; no hidden auto-approve/PT Y/stdin fallback; no automatic task acceptance; no schema/API/Port/transaction changes without owner approval.
